items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Oh yeah, he'd come to me, he said, "I'm gonna come and tell everybody something tonight, but I don't mean you.

ctx.x: Yeah, Ben was a very sweet, gentle person when he didn't take a drink. He was a completely different person when he was drinking, because he would get kind of fierce.
Oh yeah, he'd come to me, he said, "I'm gonna come and tell everybody something tonight, but I don't mean you.
Once he said to me, "Do I scare you?" and I said, "No, did you want to?" and he said, "Yes!".
